title: creational structural and behavioral design patterns
concepts: A design pattern names a recurring design problem, its participating roles, a reusable solution shape, and the consequences of applying it; it is not a code template that should be inserted automatically.
Creational patterns separate or structure object creation; structural patterns compose objects or classes; behavioral patterns organize communication and responsibility.
The same pattern can be implemented with different language features, and a simple function or composition may be clearer than a class-heavy pattern implementation.
Choose patterns from the forces in the problem, understand the added indirection and lifecycle implications, and recognize when a pattern has become unnecessary ceremony.
This manifest freezes the canonical 23 Gang of Four patterns in their established three categories; enterprise application and concurrency pattern catalogs are separate scopes.
